name: Diabolic Vision
oracle_text: Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on top of your library in any order.
blocked_sentences: Put one of them into your hand and the rest on top of your library in any order.

needs.what: A remainder option on look_at_top (e.g. rest_to_top_any_order: true) that, after the picked card is taken, lets the resolving player arrange the cards looked at and not taken in any order on top of their library (rule 401.4 ordering choice, as put_on_top's any_order does via _in_owners_order)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: look_at_top with destination hand and count 1 leaves the untaken cards on top in their original order, so the player never gets the printed choice of order; rest_to_bottom sends them to the bottom in random order, rest_to only names a zone with no ordering; put_on_top has any_order but cannot name 'the rest' because look_at_top's `as` binds only the taken cards; scry orders the top but also allows bottoming, which is a different card
